thought.text: Free trial 14 hari $25 — itu menarik. Tapi pertanyaan sebenarnya: **$25 cukup untuk apa?** Kalau harvester butuh 2 cluster, mungkin habis dalam sehari. Saya cek harga dan apa yang bisa dijalankan.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && for u in "https://cloider.com/pricing" "https://cloider.com/docs" "https://cloider.com/api/pricing" "https://cloider.com/api/plans"; do printf "%-40s " "$u"; curl -s -o /tmp/c.html -w "[%{http_code}] " --max-time 25 "$u"; grep -oiE "(\\\$[0-9.]+ ?(/|per) ?(mo|month|hour|hr|gb|vcpu)|free tier|trial)" /tmp/c.html 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -6 | tr '\n' ' '; echo; done

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/project && for u in \"https://cloider.com/pricing\" \"https://cloider.com/docs\" \"https://cloider.com/api/pricing\" \"https://cloider.com/api/plans\"; do printf \"%-40s \" \"$u\"; curl -s -o /tmp/c.html -w \"[%{http_code}] \" --max-time 25 \"$u\"; grep -oiE \"(\\\\\\$[0-9.]+ ?(/|per) ?(mo|month|hour|hr|gb|vcpu)|free tier|trial)\" /tmp/c.html 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -6 | tr '\\n' ' '; echo; done", "summary": "Check Cloider pricing pages", "security_risk": "LOW", "timeout": 160}
